defendant: CHADWICK STREET DEVELOPMENT LLC, ET AL.
description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001236
DOCKET NO. 000290 25 CTL #163236
PLAINTIFF – WILIMINGTON SAVINGS FUND SOCIETY, FSB
DEFENDANTS- CHADWICK STREET DEVELOPMENT LLC, ET AL.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 10th DAY OF November 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the City of Paterson, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax lots 6 & 7 in Block 5505
Dimensions: Lot 6: approximately 22 feet x 109 feet irregular; Lot 7: approximately 26 feet x 100 feet irregular
Nearest Cross Street: Mary Street
This concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises. A more complete metes and bounds description can be found at the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff, or in accordance with a survey prepared by Schmidt Surveying, LLC date June 19, 2022, or at the Superior Court of New Jersey, Chancery Division- Passaic County at Docket No. SWC-F-000920-25
*Subject to the Below
Lot 6:
1. Payment on the Water Account bill due to Passaic Valley Water Comm. 1525 Main Ave, Clifton NJ 07011 973-340-4300
a. Account#: 0321951-077258 To: 02/10/2026 $765.12 Paid, Subject to final reading.
b. Account#: 0321951-192084 To: 07/06/2026 $209.91 Open and Due 08/05/2026; Subject to final reading. Interest to 08/14/26-$2.10
2. Payment on the Sewer Account bill due to Paterson Sewer Dept. 155 Market Street. Paterson NJ 07501 973-321-1230
a. Account#: 10017620 0 Inactive Account; Charges pending activity; Subject to final reading
Lot 7:
1. Payment on the Water account bill due to Passaic Valley Water Comm. 1525 Main Ave Clifton NJ 07011 973-340-4300
a. Account#; 0283856-077260 Inactive Account; Charges pending Activity; Subject to final reading.
2. Payment on the Sewer Account bill due to Paterson Sewer Dept. 155 Market St. Paterson NJ 07501 973-321-1230
a. Account #: 10017621 0 Inactive account; Charges pending activity. May be subject to backbilling additonal accounts may exist
Potentially Subject to:
1. Construction Lien Claim in favor of ULE Group Corp, in the amount of $42,487.80, filed with the Passaic County Clerk at Book CLCNUB 19, Page 1 on July 17,2024
2. Construction Lien Claim in favor of SCHINDLER ELEVATOR CORPORATION in the amount of $95,715.52, filed with the Passaic County clerk at Book CLCNUMB 19 Page 157 on September 9,2024
3. Notice of unpaid balance and right to file lien in favor of STRUCTURETECH ENGINEERING PC in the amount of $161,250.00, filed with the Passaic County Clerk at Book CLCNUB 19, Page 191 on October 4, 2024
** In addition to the above, any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
46-48 CHADWICK Street Paterson, NJ 07503
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $2,698,683.12 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
Advertised in the Passaic County Sheriff Website
DATED: October 13, 2026
STRADLEY RONON STEVENS & YOUNG, LLP
457 HADDONFIELD Road
SUITE 100
CHERRY HILL, NJ 08002
